decisions.reason: Although it was not recently visible on the website, management would still tend to retain a core handle line because the design and tooling investment is sunk and it can still be justified as part of the standard range.
After several years, this more stand-alone handle design is easier to discontinue because it is less central to the firm's stated direction and weak demand is harder to frame as only temporary.

As a multi-model handle family supporting breadth in the core business, it still benefits from prior investment and from the firm's tendency to preserve established assortment coverage across project needs.

The electronic access system remains linked to the firm's publicly emphasized digital direction, so reputational commitment and strategic centrality make management relatively reluctant to withdraw it.
